blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: 1. What Steqeyma is and what it is used for
section_path: 1. What Steqeyma is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: What Steqeyma is
section_path: 1. What Steqeyma is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Steqeyma contains the active substance 'ustekinumab', a monoclonal antibody. Monoclonal antibodies are proteins that recognise and bind specifically to certain proteins in the body.
section_path: 1. What Steqeyma is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Steqeyma belongs to a group of medicines called 'immunosuppressants'. These medicines work by weakening part of the immune system.
section_path: 1. What Steqeyma is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: What Steqeyma is used for
section_path: 1. What Steqeyma is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Steqeyma administered using the pre-filled pen is used to treat the following inflammatory diseases:
section_path: 1. What Steqeyma is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Plaque psoriasis - in adults
section_path: 1. What Steqeyma is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Psoriatic arthritis - in adults
section_path: 1. What Steqeyma is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Moderate to severe Crohn's disease - in adults
section_path: 1. What Steqeyma is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Moderate to severe ulcerative colitis - in adults
section_path: 1. What Steqeyma is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Plaque psoriasis
section_path: 1. What Steqeyma is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Plaque psoriasis is a skin condition that causes inflammation affecting the skin and nails. Steqeyma will reduce the inflammation and other signs of the disease.
section_path: 1. What Steqeyma is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Steqeyma administered using the pre-filled pen is used in adults with moderate to severe plaque psoriasis, who cannot use ciclosporin, methotrexate or phototherapy, or where these treatments did not work.
section_path: 1. What Steqeyma is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Psoriatic arthritis
section_path: 1. What Steqeyma is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Psoriatic arthritis is an inflammatory disease of the joints, usually accompanied by psoriasis. If you have active psoriatic arthritis you will first be given other medicines. If you do not respond well enough to these medicines, you may be given Steqeyma to:
section_path: 1. What Steqeyma is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Reduce the signs and symptoms of your disease.
section_path: 1. What Steqeyma is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Improve your physical function.
section_path: 1. What Steqeyma is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Slow down the damage to your joints.
section_path: 1. What Steqeyma is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Crohn's disease
section_path: 1. What Steqeyma is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Crohn's disease is an inflammatory disease of the bowel. If you have Crohn's disease you will first be given other medicines. If you do not respond well enough or are intolerant to these medicines, you may be given Steqeyma to reduce the signs and symptoms of your disease.
section_path: 1. What Steqeyma is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Ulcerative colitis
section_path: 1. What Steqeyma is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Ulcerative colitis is an inflammatory disease of the bowel. If you have ulcerative colitis you will first be given other medicines. If you do not respond well enough or are intolerant to these medicines, you may be given Steqeyma to reduce the signs and symptoms of your disease.
section_path: 1. What Steqeyma is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Do not use Steqeyma
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  If you are allergic to ustekinumab or any of the other ingredients of this medicine (listed in section 6).
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  If you have an active infection which your doctor thinks is important.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: If you are not sure if any of the above applies to you, talk to your doctor or pharmacist before using Steqeyma.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Warnings and precautions
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Talk to your doctor or pharmacist before using Steqeyma. Your doctor will check how well you are before each treatment. Make sure you tell your doctor about any illness you have before each treatment. Also tell your doctor if you have recently been near anyone who might have tuberculosis. Your doctor will examine you and do a test for tuberculosis, before you have Steqeyma. If your doctor thinks you are at risk of tuberculosis, you may be given medicines to treat it.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Look out for serious side effects
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
Look out for serious side effects
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Steqeyma can cause serious side effects, including allergic reactions and infections. You must look out for certain signs of illness while you are taking Steqeyma. See 'Serious side effects' in section 4 for a full list of these side effects.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
Look out for serious side effects
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Before you use Steqeyma tell your doctor:
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
Before you use Steqeyma tell your doctor:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  If you ever had an allergic reaction to ustekinumab. Ask your doctor if you are not sure.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
Before you use Steqeyma tell your doctor:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  If you have ever had any type of cancer - this is because immunosuppressants like Steqeyma weaken part of the immune system. This may increase the risk of cancer.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
Before you use Steqeyma tell your doctor:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  If you have been treated for psoriasis with other biologic medicines (a medicine produced from a biological source and usually given by injection) - the risk of cancer may be higher.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
Before you use Steqeyma tell your doctor:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  If you have or have had a recent infection.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
Before you use Steqeyma tell your doctor:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  If you have any new or changing lesions within psoriasis areas or on normal skin.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
Before you use Steqeyma tell your doctor:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  If you are having any other treatment for psoriasis and/or psoriatic arthritis - such as another immunosuppressant or phototherapy (when your body is treated with a type of ultraviolet (UV) light). These treatments may also weaken part of the immune system. Using these therapies together with ustekinumab has not been studied. However it is possible it may increase the chance of diseases related to a weaker immune system.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
Before you use Steqeyma tell your doctor:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  If you are having or have ever had injections to treat allergies - it is not known if ustekinumab may affect these.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
Before you use Steqeyma tell your doctor:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  If you are 65 years of age or over - you may be more likely to get infections.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
Before you use Steqeyma tell your doctor:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: If you are not sure if any of the above applies to you, talk to your doctor or pharmacist before using Steqeyma.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
Before you use Steqeyma tell your doctor:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Some patients have experienced lupus-like reactions including skin lupus or lupus-like syndrome during treatment with ustekinumab. Talk to your doctor right away if you experience a red, raised, scaly rash sometimes with a darker border, in areas of the skin that are exposed to the sun or with joint pains.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
Before you use Steqeyma tell your doctor:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Heart attack and strokes
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Heart attack and strokes have been observed in a study in patients with psoriasis treated with ustekinumab. Your doctor will regularly check your risk factors for heart disease and stroke in order to ensure that they are appropriately treated. Seek medical attention right away if you develop chest pain, weakness or abnormal sensation on one side of your body, facial droop, or speech or visual abnormalities.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Children and adolescents
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: The Steqeyma pre-filled pen is not recommended for use in children and adolescents under 18 years of age with psoriasis or Crohn's disease because it has not been studied in this age group. The pre-filled syringe or vial should be used instead for children 6 years of age and older and adolescents with psoriasis. The solution for infusion, pre-filled syringe or vial should be used instead for children weighing at least 40 kg with Crohn's disease.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Steqeyma is not recommended for use in children and adolescents under 18 years of age with psoriatic arthritis, ulcerative colitis or children with Crohn's disease who weigh less than 40 kg because it has not been studied in this age group.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Other medicines, vaccines and Steqeyma
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Tell your doctor or pharmacist:
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  If you are taking, have recently taken or might take any other medicines.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  If you have recently had or are going to have a vaccination. Some types of vaccines (live vaccines) should not be given while using Steqeyma.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  If you received Steqeyma while pregnant, tell your baby's doctor about your Steqeyma treatment before the baby receives any vaccine, including live vaccines, such as the BCG vaccine (used to prevent tuberculosis). Live vaccines are not recommended for your baby in the first twelve months after birth if you received Steqeyma during the pregnancy unless your baby's doctor recommends otherwise.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Pregnancy and breast-feeding
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  If you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant or are planning to have a baby, ask your doctor for advice before taking this medicine.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  A higher risk of birth defects has not been seen in babies exposed to ustekinumab in the womb. However, there is limited experience with ustekinumab in pregnant women. It is therefore preferable to avoid the use of Steqeyma in pregnancy.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  If you are a woman of childbearing potential, you are advised to avoid becoming pregnant and must use adequate contraception while using Steqeyma and for at least 15 weeks after the last Steqeyma treatment.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Ustekinumab can pass across the placenta to the unborn baby. If you received Steqeyma during your pregnancy, your baby may have a higher risk for getting an infection.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  It is important that you tell your baby's doctors and other health care professionals if you received Steqeyma during your pregnancy before the baby receives any vaccine. Live vaccines such as the BCG vaccine (used to prevent tuberculosis) are not recommended for your baby in the first twelve months after birth if you received Steqeyma during the pregnancy unless your baby's doctor recommends otherwise.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Ustekinumab may pass into breast milk in very small amounts. Talk to your doctor if you are breast-feeding or are planning to breast-feed. You and your doctor should decide if you should breast-feed or use Steqeyma - do not do both.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Driving and using machines
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Steqeyma has no or negligible influence on the ability to drive and use machines.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Steqeyma contains polysorbate 80
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Steqeyma contains 0.02 mg of polysorbate 80 (E433) in each dosage unit which is equivalent to 0.04 mg/mL. Polysorbates may cause allergic reactions. Tell your doctor if you have any known allergies.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: 3. How to use Steqeyma
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Steqeyma is intended for use under the guidance and supervision of a doctor experienced in treating conditions for which Steqeyma is intended.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Always use this medicine exactly as your doctor has told you. Check with your doctor if you are not sure. Talk to your doctor about when you will have your injections and follow-up appointments.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: How much Steqeyma is given
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Your doctor will decide how much Steqeyma you need to use and for how long.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Adults aged 18 years or older
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Psoriasis or Psoriatic Arthritis
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  The recommended starting dose is 45 mg Steqeyma. Patients who weigh more than 100 kilograms (kg) may start on a dose of 90 mg instead of 45 mg.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  After the starting dose, you will have the next dose 4 weeks later, and then every 12 weeks. The following doses are usually the same as the starting dose.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Crohn's disease or Ulcerative Colitis
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  During treatment, the first dose of approximately 6 mg/kg Steqeyma will be given by your doctor through a drip in a vein in your arm (intravenous infusion). After the starting dose, you will receive the next dose of 90 mg Steqeyma after 8 weeks, then every 12 weeks thereafter by an injection under the skin ('subcutaneously').
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  In some patients, after the first injection under the skin, 90 mg Steqeyma may be given every 8 weeks. Your doctor will decide when you should receive your next dose.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: How Steqeyma is given
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Steqeyma is given as an injection under the skin ('subcutaneously'). At the start of your treatment, medical or nursing staff may inject Steqeyma.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  However, you and your doctor may decide that you may inject Steqeyma yourself. In this case you will get training on how to inject Steqeyma yourself.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  For instructions on how to inject Steqeyma, see 'Instructions for administration' at the end of this leaflet.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Talk to your doctor if you have any questions about giving yourself an injection.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: If you use more Steqeyma than you should
section_path: If you use more Steqeyma than you should
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: If you have used or been given too much Steqeyma, talk to a doctor or pharmacist straight away. Always have the outer carton of the medicine with you, even if it is empty.
section_path: If you use more Steqeyma than you should
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: If you forget to use Steqeyma
section_path: If you forget to use Steqeyma
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: If you forget a dose, contact your doctor or pharmacist. Do not take a double dose to make up for a forgotten dose.
section_path: If you forget to use Steqeyma
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: If you stop using Steqeyma
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: It is not dangerous to stop using Steqeyma. However, if you stop, your symptoms may come back.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: If you have any further questions on the use of this medicine, ask your doctor or pharmacist.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: 4. Possible side effects
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Like all medicines, this medicine can cause side effects, although not everybody gets them.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Serious side effects
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Some patients may have serious side effects that may need urgent treatment.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Allergic reactions - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor or get emergency medical help straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Serious allergic reactions ('anaphylaxis') are rare in people taking ustekinumab (may affect up to 1 in 1 000 people). Signs include:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: difficulty breathing or swallowing
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: low blood pressure, which can cause dizziness or light-headedness
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: swelling of the face, lips, mouth or throat.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Common signs of an allergic reaction include skin rash and hives (these may affect up to 1 in 100 people).
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: In rare cases, allergic lung reactions and lung inflammation have been reported in patients who receive ustekinumab. Tell your doctor right away if you develop symptoms such as cough, shortness of breath, and fever.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: If you have a serious allergic reaction, your doctor may decide that you should not use Steqeyma again.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Infections of the nose or throat and common cold are common (may affect up to 1 in 10 people)
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Infections of the chest are uncommon (may affect up to 1 in 100 people)
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Inflammation of tissue under the skin ('cellulitis') is uncommon (may affect up to 1 in 100 people)
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Shingles (a type of painful rash with blisters) are uncommon (may affect up to 1 in 100 people)
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Steqeyma may make you less able to fight infections. Some infections could become serious and may include infections caused by viruses, fungi, bacteria (including tuberculosis), or parasites, including infections that mainly occur in people with a weakened immune system (opportunistic infections). Opportunistic infections of the brain (encephalitis, meningitis), lungs, and eye have been reported in patients receiving treatment with ustekinumab.
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: You must look out for signs of infection while you are using Steqeyma. These include:
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  fever, flu-like symptoms, night sweats, weight loss
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  feeling tired or short of breath; cough which will not go away
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  warm, red and painful skin, or a painful skin rash with blisters
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  burning when passing water
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  diarrhoea
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  visual disturbance or vision loss
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  headache, neck stiffness, light sensitivity, nausea or confusion.
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of these signs of infection. These may be signs of infections such as chest infections, skin infections, shingles or opportunistic infections that could have serious complications. Tell your doctor if you have any kind of infection that will not go away or keeps coming back. Your doctor may decide that you should not use Steqeyma until the infection goes away. Also tell your doctor if you have any open cuts or sores as they might get infected.
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Shedding of skin - increase in redness and shedding of skin over a larger area of the body may be symptoms of erythrodermic psoriasis or exfoliative dermatitis, which are serious skin conditions. You should tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of these signs.
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Other side effects
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Common side effects (may affect up to 1 in 10 people):
section_path: Common side effects (may affect up to 1 in 10 people):

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Diarrhoea
section_path: Common side effects (may affect up to 1 in 10 people):

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Nausea
section_path: Common side effects (may affect up to 1 in 10 people):

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Vomiting
section_path: Common side effects (may affect up to 1 in 10 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Feeling tired
section_path: Common side effects (may affect up to 1 in 10 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Feeling dizzy
section_path: Common side effects (may affect up to 1 in 10 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Headache
section_path: Common side effects (may affect up to 1 in 10 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Itching ('pruritus')
section_path: Common side effects (may affect up to 1 in 10 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Back, muscle or joint pain
section_path: Common side effects (may affect up to 1 in 10 people):

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Sore throat
section_path: Common side effects (may affect up to 1 in 10 people):

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Redness and pain where the injection is given
section_path: Common side effects (may affect up to 1 in 10 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Sinus infection
section_path: Common side effects (may affect up to 1 in 10 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Uncommon side effects (may affect up to 1 in 100 people):
section_path: Common side effects (may affect up to 1 in 10 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Tooth infections
section_path: Common side effects (may affect up to 1 in 10 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Vaginal yeast infection
section_path: Common side effects (may affect up to 1 in 10 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Depression
section_path: Common side effects (may affect up to 1 in 10 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Blocked or stuffy nose
section_path: Common side effects (may affect up to 1 in 10 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Bleeding, bruising, hardness, swelling and itching where the injection is given
section_path: Common side effects (may affect up to 1 in 10 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Feeling weak
section_path: Common side effects (may affect up to 1 in 10 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Drooping eyelid and sagging muscles on one side of the face ('facial palsy' or 'Bell's palsy'), which is usually temporary
section_path: Common side effects (may affect up to 1 in 10 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  A change in psoriasis with redness and new tiny, yellow or white skin blisters, sometimes accompanied by fever (pustular psoriasis)
section_path: Common side effects (may affect up to 1 in 10 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Peeling of the skin (skin exfoliation)
section_path: Common side effects (may affect up to 1 in 10 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Acne
section_path: Common side effects (may affect up to 1 in 10 people):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Rare side effects (may affect up to 1 in 1 000 people)
section_path: Rare side effects (may affect up to 1 in 1 000 people)
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Redness and shedding of skin over a larger area of the body, which may be itchy or painful (exfoliative dermatitis). Similar symptoms sometimes develop as a natural change in the type of psoriasis symptoms (erythrodermic psoriasis)
section_path: Rare side effects (may affect up to 1 in 1 000 people)
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Inflammation of small blood vessels, which can lead to a skin rash with small red or purple bumps, fever or joint pain (vasculitis)
section_path: Rare side effects (may affect up to 1 in 1 000 people)
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Very rare side effects (may affect up to 1 in 10 000 people)
section_path: Very rare side effects (may affect up to 1 in 10 000 people)
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Blistering of the skin that may be red, itchy, and painful (Bullous pemphigoid).
section_path: Very rare side effects (may affect up to 1 in 10 000 people)
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Skin lupus or lupus-like syndrome (red, raised scaly rash on areas of the skin exposed to the sun possibly with joint pains).
section_path: Very rare side effects (may affect up to 1 in 10 000 people)
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Reporting of side effects
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: If you get any side effects, talk to your doctor or pharmacist. This includes any possible side effects not listed in this leaflet. You can also report side effects directly via the national reporting system listed in Appendix V. By reporting side effects you can help provide more information on the safety of this medicine.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: 5. How to store Steqeyma
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Keep this medicine out of the sight and reach of children.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Store in a refrigerator (2 °C-8 °C). Do not freeze.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Keep the pre-filled pen in the outer carton in order to protect from light.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  If needed, individual Steqeyma pre-filled pens may also be stored at room temperature up to 25 °C for a maximum single period of up to 31 days in the original carton in order to protect from light. Record the date when the pre-filled pen is first removed from the refrigerator in the space provided on the outer carton. At any time before the end of this 31-day period at room temperature, the product can be returned to the refrigerator once, and stored there until the original expiry date. Discard the pen if not used within 31 days at room temperature storage or by the original expiry date, whichever is earlier.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Do not shake Steqeyma pre-filled pens. Prolonged vigorous shaking may damage the medicine.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Do not use this medicine:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  After the expiry date which is stated on the label and the carton after 'EXP'. The expiry date refers to the last day of that month.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  If the liquid is discoloured, cloudy or you can see other foreign particles floating in it (see section 6 'What Steqeyma looks like and contents of the pack').
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  If you know, or think that it may have been exposed to extreme temperatures (such as accidentally frozen or heated).
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  If the product has been shaken vigorously.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Steqeyma is for single use only. Any unused product remaining in the pre-filled pen should be thrown away. Do not throw away any medicines via wastewater or household waste. Ask your pharmacist how to throw away medicines you no longer use. These measures will help protect the environment.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Instructions for administration
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: At the start of treatment, your healthcare provider will assist you with your first injection. However, you and your doctor may decide that you may inject Steqeyma yourself. If this happens, you will get training on how to inject Steqeyma. Talk to your doctor if you have any questions about giving yourself an injection.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Important Information
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Use the pre-filled pen only if your healthcare provider has trained you on the right way to prepare for and to give an injection. Do not try to inject yourself until you have been trained by your doctor.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Do not reuse the pre-filled pen.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Do not open the sealed carton until you are ready to use the pre-filled pen.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Do not remove the cap until just before you give the injection.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Do not mix Steqeyma with other liquids for injection.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Do not use if the pre-filled pen is cracked or damaged.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Do not use the medicine if the expiration date has passed.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Do not share the pre-filled pen with anyone.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: The pre-filled pen cannot be re-used. Dispose of the used pre-filled pen immediately after use in a sharps disposal container (see Step 15. Dispose of the pre-filled pen).
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Storing the pre-filled pen
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Keep the pre-filled pen out of the sight and reach of children. This product contains small parts.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Store the pre-filled pen in a refrigerator between 2°C and 8°C.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Do not freeze the pre-filled pen.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: If needed, individual Steqeyma pre-filled pens may also be stored at room temperature up to 25°C for a maximum single period of up to 31 days in the original carton in order to protect from light.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Record the date when the pre-filled pens are first removed from the refrigerator in the spaces provided on the outer carton.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: At any time before the end of the storage period at room temperature, the product can be returned to the refrigerator once, and stored there until the original expiry date.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Store this medicine sealed inside its carton to protect it from light.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Do not use the pre-filled pen if it has been left in direct sunlight.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Do not shake Steqeyma pre-filled pens. Strong shaking may damage the medicine.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Do not use the medicine if it has been shaken.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Do not use if the pre-filled pen has been dropped on a hard surface.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Always keep the pre-filled pen dry.
section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.text: 3. Wait 30 minutes.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Open the carton and remove the pre-filled pen.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.text: Leave the pre-filled pen at room temperature (20°C to 25°C) for about 30 minutes to allow it to warm up (see Figure D).
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: This will let the liquid come to a comfortable temperature for injection (room temperature).
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Do not warm the pre-filled pen using heat sources such as hot water or a microwave.

blocks.text: 4. Inspect the pre-filled pen.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Look at the pre-filled pen and make sure you have the correct medicine (Steqeyma) and dosage.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Check the pre-filled pen(s) to make sure the number of pre-filled pens is correct:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: if your dose is 45 mg you will get one 45 mg pre-filled pen of Steqeyma.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: if your dose is 90 mg you will get two 45 mg pre-filled pens of Steqeyma and you will need to give yourself two injections. Choose two different sites for these injections (e.g. one injection in the right thigh and the other injection in the left thigh), and give the injections one right after the other.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Look at the pre-filled pen and make sure it is not cracked or damaged.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Check the expiration date on the label of the pre-filled pen (see Figure E).
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Do not shake the pre-filled pen.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Do not use the pre-filled pen if:

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: it has been cracked or damaged.

blocks.text: the expiration date has passed.

blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Look at the medicine and confirm that the liquid is clear to slightly opalescent, colourless to pale yellow (see Figure F).
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Do not use the pre-filled pen if the liquid is discoloured, cloudy, or has large particles.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: You may see air bubbles in the liquid. This is normal.

section_path: 6. Choose an injection site (see Figure G):

section_path: 6. Choose an injection site (see Figure G):
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Do not inject through your clothes.
section_path: 6. Choose an injection site (see Figure G):

blocks.label: list_item

blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Let the skin dry before injecting.

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: 9. Remove the cap
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Hold the pre-filled pen in one hand by the injector body with the cap on top. Gently pull the cap straight off with the other hand (see Figure J).
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Do not remove the cap until you are ready to inject.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: It is normal to see a few drops of liquid come out of the needle.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Do not touch the needle or needle cover. Doing so may result in a needle stick injury because the needle is inside the needle cover.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Inject STEQEYMA within 5 minutes of removing the cap.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Do not re-cap the pre-filled pen.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: Dispose of the cap right away in a sharps disposal container (see Step 15 and Figure J).

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: 1. What Steqeyma is and what it is used for
section_path: 1. What Steqeyma is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: What Steqeyma is
section_path: 1. What Steqeyma is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Steqeyma contains the active substance 'ustekinumab', a monoclonal antibody. Monoclonal antibodies are proteins that recognise and bind specifically to certain proteins in the body.
section_path: 1. What Steqeyma is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Steqeyma belongs to a group of medicines called 'immunosuppressants'. These medicines work by weakening part of the immune system.
section_path: 1. What Steqeyma is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: What Steqeyma is used for
section_path: 1. What Steqeyma is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Steqeyma administered using the pre-filled pen is used to treat the following inflammatory diseases:
section_path: 1. What Steqeyma is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Plaque psoriasis - in adults
section_path: 1. What Steqeyma is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Psoriatic arthritis - in adults
section_path: 1. What Steqeyma is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Moderate to severe Crohn's disease - in adults
section_path: 1. What Steqeyma is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Moderate to severe ulcerative colitis - in adults
section_path: 1. What Steqeyma is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Plaque psoriasis
section_path: 1. What Steqeyma is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Plaque psoriasis is a skin condition that causes inflammation affecting the skin and nails. Steqeyma will reduce the inflammation and other signs of the disease.
section_path: 1. What Steqeyma is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Steqeyma administered using the pre-filled pen is used in adults with moderate to severe plaque psoriasis, who cannot use ciclosporin, methotrexate or phototherapy, or where these treatments did not work.
section_path: 1. What Steqeyma is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Psoriatic arthritis
section_path: 1. What Steqeyma is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Psoriatic arthritis is an inflammatory disease of the joints, usually accompanied by psoriasis. If you have active psoriatic arthritis you will first be given other medicines. If you do not respond well enough to these medicines, you may be given Steqeyma to:
section_path: 1. What Steqeyma is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Reduce the signs and symptoms of your disease.
section_path: 1. What Steqeyma is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Improve your physical function.
section_path: 1. What Steqeyma is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Slow down the damage to your joints.
section_path: 1. What Steqeyma is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Crohn's disease
section_path: 1. What Steqeyma is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Crohn's disease is an inflammatory disease of the bowel. If you have Crohn's disease you will first be given other medicines. If you do not respond well enough or are intolerant to these medicines, you may be given Steqeyma to reduce the signs and symptoms of your disease.
section_path: 1. What Steqeyma is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Ulcerative colitis
section_path: 1. What Steqeyma is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Ulcerative colitis is an inflammatory disease of the bowel. If you have ulcerative colitis you will first be given other medicines. If you do not respond well enough or are intolerant to these medicines, you may be given Steqeyma to reduce the signs and symptoms of your disease.
section_path: 1. What Steqeyma is and what it is used for
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Do not use Steqeyma
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  If you are allergic to ustekinumab or any of the other ingredients of this medicine (listed in section 6).
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  If you have an active infection which your doctor thinks is important.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: If you are not sure if any of the above applies to you, talk to your doctor or pharmacist before using Steqeyma.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Warnings and precautions
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Talk to your doctor or pharmacist before using Steqeyma. Your doctor will check how well you are before each treatment. Make sure you tell your doctor about any illness you have before each treatment. Also tell your doctor if you have recently been near anyone who might have tuberculosis. Your doctor will examine you and do a test for tuberculosis, before you have Steqeyma. If your doctor thinks you are at risk of tuberculosis, you may be given medicines to treat it.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Look out for serious side effects
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
Look out for serious side effects
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Steqeyma can cause serious side effects, including allergic reactions and infections. You must look out for certain signs of illness while you are taking Steqeyma. See 'Serious side effects' in section 4 for a full list of these side effects.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
Look out for serious side effects
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Before you use Steqeyma tell your doctor:
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
Before you use Steqeyma tell your doctor:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  If you ever had an allergic reaction to ustekinumab. Ask your doctor if you are not sure.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
Before you use Steqeyma tell your doctor:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  If you have ever had any type of cancer - this is because immunosuppressants like Steqeyma weaken part of the immune system. This may increase the risk of cancer.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
Before you use Steqeyma tell your doctor:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  If you have been treated for psoriasis with other biologic medicines (a medicine produced from a biological source and usually given by injection) - the risk of cancer may be higher.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
Before you use Steqeyma tell your doctor:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  If you have or have had a recent infection.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
Before you use Steqeyma tell your doctor:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  If you have any new or changing lesions within psoriasis areas or on normal skin.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
Before you use Steqeyma tell your doctor:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  If you are having any other treatment for psoriasis and/or psoriatic arthritis - such as another immunosuppressant or phototherapy (when your body is treated with a type of ultraviolet (UV) light). These treatments may also weaken part of the immune system. Using these therapies together with ustekinumab has not been studied. However it is possible it may increase the chance of diseases related to a weaker immune system.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
Before you use Steqeyma tell your doctor:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  If you are having or have ever had injections to treat allergies - it is not known if ustekinumab may affect these.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
Before you use Steqeyma tell your doctor:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  If you are 65 years of age or over - you may be more likely to get infections.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
Before you use Steqeyma tell your doctor:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: If you are not sure if any of the above applies to you, talk to your doctor or pharmacist before using Steqeyma.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
Before you use Steqeyma tell your doctor:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Some patients have experienced lupus-like reactions including skin lupus or lupus-like syndrome during treatment with ustekinumab. Talk to your doctor right away if you experience a red, raised, scaly rash sometimes with a darker border, in areas of the skin that are exposed to the sun or with joint pains.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
Before you use Steqeyma tell your doctor:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Heart attack and strokes
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Heart attack and strokes have been observed in a study in patients with psoriasis treated with ustekinumab. Your doctor will regularly check your risk factors for heart disease and stroke in order to ensure that they are appropriately treated. Seek medical attention right away if you develop chest pain, weakness or abnormal sensation on one side of your body, facial droop, or speech or visual abnormalities.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Children and adolescents
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: The Steqeyma pre-filled pen is not recommended for use in children and adolescents under 18 years of age with psoriasis or Crohn's disease because it has not been studied in this age group. The pre-filled syringe or vial should be used instead for children 6 years of age and older and adolescents with psoriasis. The solution for infusion, pre-filled syringe or vial should be used instead for children weighing at least 40 kg with Crohn's disease.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Steqeyma is not recommended for use in children and adolescents under 18 years of age with psoriatic arthritis, ulcerative colitis or children with Crohn's disease who weigh less than 40 kg because it has not been studied in this age group.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Other medicines, vaccines and Steqeyma
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Tell your doctor or pharmacist:
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  If you are taking, have recently taken or might take any other medicines.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  If you have recently had or are going to have a vaccination. Some types of vaccines (live vaccines) should not be given while using Steqeyma.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  If you received Steqeyma while pregnant, tell your baby's doctor about your Steqeyma treatment before the baby receives any vaccine, including live vaccines, such as the BCG vaccine (used to prevent tuberculosis). Live vaccines are not recommended for your baby in the first twelve months after birth if you received Steqeyma during the pregnancy unless your baby's doctor recommends otherwise.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Pregnancy and breast-feeding
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  If you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant or are planning to have a baby, ask your doctor for advice before taking this medicine.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  A higher risk of birth defects has not been seen in babies exposed to ustekinumab in the womb. However, there is limited experience with ustekinumab in pregnant women. It is therefore preferable to avoid the use of Steqeyma in pregnancy.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  If you are a woman of childbearing potential, you are advised to avoid becoming pregnant and must use adequate contraception while using Steqeyma and for at least 15 weeks after the last Steqeyma treatment.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Ustekinumab can pass across the placenta to the unborn baby. If you received Steqeyma during your pregnancy, your baby may have a higher risk for getting an infection.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  It is important that you tell your baby's doctors and other health care professionals if you received Steqeyma during your pregnancy before the baby receives any vaccine. Live vaccines such as the BCG vaccine (used to prevent tuberculosis) are not recommended for your baby in the first twelve months after birth if you received Steqeyma during the pregnancy unless your baby's doctor recommends otherwise.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Ustekinumab may pass into breast milk in very small amounts. Talk to your doctor if you are breast-feeding or are planning to breast-feed. You and your doctor should decide if you should breast-feed or use Steqeyma - do not do both.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Driving and using machines
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Steqeyma has no or negligible influence on the ability to drive and use machines.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Steqeyma contains polysorbate 80
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Steqeyma contains 0.04 mg of polysorbate 80 (E433) in each dosage unit which is equivalent to 0.04 mg/mL. Polysorbates may cause allergic reactions. Tell your doctor if you have any known allergies.
section_path: 2. What you need to know before you use Steqeyma
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: 3. How to use Steqeyma
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Steqeyma is intended for use under the guidance and supervision of a doctor experienced in treating conditions for which Steqeyma is intended.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Always use this medicine exactly as your doctor has told you. Check with your doctor if you are not sure. Talk to your doctor about when you will have your injections and follow-up appointments.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: How much Steqeyma is given
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Your doctor will decide how much Steqeyma you need to use and for how long.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Adults aged 18 years or older
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Psoriasis or Psoriatic Arthritis
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  The recommended starting dose is 45 mg Steqeyma. Patients who weigh more than 100 kilograms (kg) may start on a dose of 90 mg instead of 45 mg.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  After the starting dose, you will have the next dose 4 weeks later, and then every 12 weeks. The following doses are usually the same as the starting dose.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Crohn's disease or Ulcerative Colitis
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  During treatment, the first dose of approximately 6 mg/kg Steqeyma will be given by your doctor through a drip in a vein in your arm (intravenous infusion). After the starting dose, you will receive the next dose of 90 mg Steqeyma after 8 weeks, then every 12 weeks thereafter by an injection under the skin ('subcutaneously').
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  In some patients, after the first injection under the skin, 90 mg Steqeyma may be given every 8 weeks. Your doctor will decide when you should receive your next dose.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: How Steqeyma is given
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Steqeyma is given as an injection under the skin ('subcutaneously'). At the start of your treatment, medical or nursing staff may inject Steqeyma.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  However, you and your doctor may decide that you may inject Steqeyma yourself. In this case you will get training on how to inject Steqeyma yourself.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  For instructions on how to inject Steqeyma, see 'Instructions for administration' at the end of this leaflet.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Talk to your doctor if you have any questions about giving yourself an injection.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: If you use more Steqeyma than you should
section_path: If you use more Steqeyma than you should
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: If you have used or been given too much Steqeyma, talk to a doctor or pharmacist straight away. Always have the outer carton of the medicine with you, even if it is empty.
section_path: If you use more Steqeyma than you should
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: If you forget to use Steqeyma
section_path: If you forget to use Steqeyma
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: If you forget a dose, contact your doctor or pharmacist. Do not take a double dose to make up for a forgotten dose.
section_path: If you forget to use Steqeyma
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: If you stop using Steqeyma
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: It is not dangerous to stop using Steqeyma. However, if you stop, your symptoms may come back.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: If you have any further questions on the use of this medicine, ask your doctor or pharmacist.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: 4. Possible side effects
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Like all medicines, this medicine can cause side effects, although not everybody gets them.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Serious side effects
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Some patients may have serious side effects that may need urgent treatment.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Allergic reactions - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor or get emergency medical help straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
section_path: Allergic reactions - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor or get emergency medical help straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Serious allergic reactions ('anaphylaxis') are rare in people taking ustekinumab (may affect up to 1 in 1 000 people). Signs include:
section_path: Allergic reactions - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor or get emergency medical help straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: difficulty breathing or swallowing
section_path: Allergic reactions - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor or get emergency medical help straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: low blood pressure, which can cause dizziness or light-headedness
section_path: Allergic reactions - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor or get emergency medical help straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: swelling of the face, lips, mouth or throat.
section_path: Allergic reactions - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor or get emergency medical help straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Common signs of an allergic reaction include skin rash and hives (these may affect up to 1 in 100 people).
section_path: Allergic reactions - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor or get emergency medical help straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: In rare cases, allergic lung reactions and lung inflammation have been reported in patients who receive ustekinumab. Tell your doctor right away if you develop symptoms such as cough, shortness of breath, and fever.
section_path: Allergic reactions - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor or get emergency medical help straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: If you have a serious allergic reaction, your doctor may decide that you should not use Steqeyma again.
section_path: Allergic reactions - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor or get emergency medical help straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Infections of the nose or throat and common cold are common (may affect up to 1 in 10 people)
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Infections of the chest are uncommon (may affect up to 1 in 100 people)
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Inflammation of tissue under the skin ('cellulitis') is uncommon (may affect up to 1 in 100 people)
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Shingles (a type of painful rash with blisters) are uncommon (may affect up to 1 in 100 people)
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Steqeyma may make you less able to fight infections. Some infections could become serious and may include infections caused by viruses, fungi, bacteria (including tuberculosis), or parasites, including infections that mainly occur in people with a weakened immune system (opportunistic infections). Opportunistic infections of the brain (encephalitis, meningitis), lungs, and eye have been reported in patients receiving treatment with ustekinumab.
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: You must look out for signs of infection while you are using Steqeyma. These include:
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  fever, flu-like symptoms, night sweats, weight loss
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  feeling tired or short of breath; cough which will not go away
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  warm, red and painful skin, or a painful skin rash with blisters
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  burning when passing water
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  diarrhoea
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  visual disturbance or vision loss
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  headache, neck stiffness, light sensitivity, nausea or confusion.
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of these signs of infection. These may be signs of infections such as chest infections, skin infections, shingles or opportunistic infections that could have serious complications. Tell your doctor if you have any kind of infection that will not go away or keeps coming back. Your doctor may decide that you should not use Steqeyma until the infection goes away. Also tell your doctor if you have any open cuts or sores as they might get infected.
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Shedding of skin - increase in redness and shedding of skin over a larger area of the body may be symptoms of erythrodermic psoriasis or exfoliative dermatitis, which are serious skin conditions. You should tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of these signs.
section_path: Infections - these may need urgent treatment. Tell your doctor straight away if you notice any of the following signs.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: If you get any side effects, talk to your doctor or pharmacist. This includes any possible side effects not listed in this leaflet. You can also report side effects directly via the national reporting system listed in Appendix V. By reporting side effects you can help provide more information on the safety of this medicine.

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: 5. How to store Steqeyma
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Keep this medicine out of the sight and reach of children.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Store in a refrigerator (2 °C-8 °C). Do not freeze.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Keep the pre-filled pen in the outer carton in order to protect from light.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  If needed, individual Steqeyma pre-filled pens may also be stored at room temperature up to 25 °C for a maximum single period of up to 31 days in the original carton in order to protect from light. Record the date when the pre-filled pen is first removed from the refrigerator in the space provided on the outer carton. At any time before the end of this 31-day period at room temperature, the product can be returned to the refrigerator once, and stored there until the original expiry date. Discard the pen if not used within 31 days at room temperature storage or by the original expiry date, whichever is earlier.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  Do not shake Steqeyma pre-filled pens. Prolonged vigorous shaking may damage the medicine.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Do not use this medicine:
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  After the expiry date which is stated on the label and the carton after 'EXP'. The expiry date refers to the last day of that month.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  If the liquid is discoloured, cloudy or you can see other foreign particles floating in it (see section 6 'What Steqeyma looks like and contents of the pack').
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  If you know, or think that it may have been exposed to extreme temperatures (such as accidentally frozen or heated).
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text:  If the product has been shaken vigorously.
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Steqeyma is for single use only. Any unused product remaining in the pen should be thrown away. Do not throw away any medicines via wastewater or household waste. Ask your pharmacist how to throw away medicines you no longer use. These measures will help protect the environment.
blocks.speaker: label

section_path: 6. Contents of the pack and other information
What Steqeyma looks like and contents of the pack
blocks.speaker: label

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Steqeyma is a clear to slightly opalescent (having a pearl-like shine), colourless to pale yellow solution for injection. The solution may contain a few small translucent or white particles of protein. It is supplied as a carton pack containing 1 single-dose, glass 1 mL pre-filled pen. Each pre-filled pen contains 90 mg ustekinumab in 1 mL of solution for injection.

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: At the start of treatment, your healthcare provider will assist you with your first injection. However, you and your doctor may decide that you may inject Steqeyma yourself.
